input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: Section 14.10 restricts only Customer: we need IBM's consent for any non-successor assignment (including to our own affiliates), while IBM is left free to assign the Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. That asymmetry fails even the fallback, which requires that every non-successor assignment need consent on both sides. The redline keeps the clause structure but frees our affiliate and successor assignments, subjects IBM assignment to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) with no assignment to a competitor, and confirms that a change of control of Bluefly gives IBM no termination right (none exists today, so this is confirmatory).

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.

proposal.summary: Make assignment mutual: Customer free to assign to affiliates/successors; IBM assignment requires our consent and never to a competitor; no IBM termination on our change of control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need assignment to run both ways: our playbook position is that we may assign to an affiliate or successor without consent, IBM may not assign without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor of ours, and our change of control gives IBM no termination right. As drafted only we are restricted while IBM is free to assign to anyone.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Customer may assign this Agreement without IBM's consent to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. IBM will not assign this Agreement without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and will not assign to a competitor of Customer.

ops.text: A change of control of Customer will not give IBM any right to terminate this Agreement.
